title: Kid Mode: hold GO and the race driver rides your quad
summary: Single Race Difficulty now cycles Normal, Expert, Kid. Kid is a one-player Single Race choice; race links and hosted rooms turn it into Normal. In a Kid race, holding GO lets the race path driver ride the player's quad (steering, lean, throttle, brake and now the CPUs' tricks); releasing GO turns the driver off and brakes fully. GO is any touch except the toolbar, Space/Up/W/Enter, or a gamepad's A button or right trigger. On touch the normal controls are hidden and a single GO disc appears only under a finger.
details: The CPUs race at Normal: the exact build has no easier CPU setting, because Easy and Normal share AI options and only Expert drops AI flag 0x400.
Kid races record no Hall of Fame or personal records and give no Profile Points.
Verification: unit tests plus the browser test tools/test_engine_race_kid.mjs on a phone-size touch screen (issue #526, PR #528). Host-verified; no physical phone or controller run.
limitation: Kid is a non-original enhancement. A motorcycle ride does no tricks. There is no Kid in Freestyle or other courseless rides.
